title: M3 fold-fitted preprocessing artifact / M3 折内拟合预处理制品
description: Contract for scalers, imputers or other data-derived preprocessing state fitted exclusively on the training subjects of one corrected M2 SGKF split. / 仅在一个校正后 M2 SGKF 划分的训练受试者上拟合的缩放器、插补器或其他数据派生预处理状态合同。

schema_version.description: Exact artifact schema identifier. / 精确制品 Schema 标识。

artifact_id.description: Unique artifact identifier including repeat and fold identity. / 包含 repeat 与 fold 身份的唯一制品标识。

status.description: locked means parameters were fitted and frozen; templates are not valid benchmark inputs. / locked 表示参数已拟合并冻结；模板不得作为 benchmark 输入。

dataset_version_id.description: Frozen M2 dataset identity for the 29-subject corpus. / 29 名受试者语料的冻结 M2 数据集标识。

dataset_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of frailty3_file_manifest.csv. / frailty3_file_manifest.csv 的 SHA-256。

fold_registry_id.description: Only the corrected subject-level StratifiedGroupKFold registry is valid for future M3/M4 benchmarks. / 未来 M3/M4 benchmark 仅允许校正后的受试者级 StratifiedGroupKFold 注册表。

fold_registry_sha256.description: Exact byte hash of the materialized M2 fold-registry JSON file. / 已物化 M2 折叠注册表 JSON 文件的精确逐字节哈希。

fold_registry_payload_sha256.description: Canonical fold payload hash used by m2.result_provenance.v1; kept separately from the file hash. / m2.result_provenance.v1 使用的规范 fold 载荷哈希；与文件哈希分开保存。

protocol_id.description: Frozen corrected OOF evaluation protocol. / 冻结的校正后 OOF 评估协议。

repeat_index.description: Zero-based repeat index. / 从零开始的重复编号。

split_seed.description: Frozen split seed; repeat_index-to-seed consistency is checked by the validator. / 冻结划分种子；validator 检查 repeat_index 与 seed 的对应关系。

fold_index.description: Zero-based fold index within the repeat. / 重复内从零开始的折编号。

training_seed.description: Training random seed, recorded separately from the split seed. / 训练随机种子，与划分种子分开记录。

preprocessing_registry_id.description: M3 preprocessing registry used before fitting. / 拟合前使用的 M3 预处理注册表。

preprocessing_profile_ids.description: Exact registered M3 profiles used to construct the fitted feature view. / 构造拟合特征视图所使用的精确 M3 注册配置。

preprocessing_profile_payload_sha256.description: Canonical payload hash keyed by every preprocessing_profile_id, preventing a stable ID from hiding changed parameters. / 以每个 preprocessing_profile_id 为键的规范载荷哈希，防止稳定 ID 隐藏参数变化。

feature_schema_version.description: Feature schema whose ordered fields the transformer parameters address. / 变换器参数所对应的有序特征 Schema。

fit_scope.description: Normative leakage barrier: no OOF subject, test subject or full-dataset statistic may be used. / 规范防泄漏边界：不得使用 OOF 受试者、测试受试者或全数据集统计量。

subject_partition.description: Exact subject sets; the validator enforces non-empty, disjoint sets and equality to the M2 fold registry. / 精确受试者集合；validator 强制非空、互斥并与 M2 折叠注册表一致。

transformers.description: Ordered fitted transforms applied after deterministic signal preprocessing. / 在确定性信号预处理之后依次应用的折内拟合变换。

parameters_sha256.description: SHA-256 over canonical fitted parameter payload; null is allowed only for template_not_fitted. / 规范拟合参数载荷的 SHA-256；仅 template_not_fitted 可为 null。

producer_callable.description: Future-active M3 callable that produced the artifact. / 生成制品的未来活动 M3 callable。

producer_source_path.description: Exact M3 source path; root scripts are forbidden. / 精确 M3 源码路径；禁止根目录脚本。

created_utc.description: UTC creation timestamp. / UTC 创建时间。

sha256.description: Lower-case SHA-256 digest. / 小写 SHA-256 摘要。

subject_ids.description: Sorted unique subject identifiers. / 排序后的唯一受试者标识。

numeric_vector.description: Finite numeric values; unavailable entries use null, never NaN or infinity. / 有限数值；不可用项使用 null，禁止 NaN 或无穷值。

transformer_id.description: Unique transform ID within the artifact. / 制品内唯一变换标识。

method.description: Declared fit algorithm; hidden library defaults are forbidden. / 已声明拟合算法；禁止隐藏的库默认值。

stage.description: Feature stage transformed by these parameters. / 参数作用的特征阶段。

feature_names.description: Ordered feature names. / 有序特征名称。

fit_dtype.description: Fitting statistics are accumulated in float64. / 拟合统计量以 float64 累积。

zero_scale_mask.description: True where a zero training-fold scale required a deterministic safe divisor. / 训练折尺度为零且需确定性安全除数的位置为 true。

parameters.description: All vectors must have the same length as feature_names; enforced by the M3 validator. / 所有向量长度必须与 feature_names 相同；由 M3 validator 强制检查。
